title: New Matrix opens in edit with one empty range and tiers on previous tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Note how many matrices the Matrices tab label shows (for example 7).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Matrix.
  3. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows 7 matrices.

Step 2:

  • The page opens in edit with an empty name field.
  • The grid has one range from $0.00 with an empty Default cell.
  • Every tier column's picker reads Previous tier.
  • Cancel and Create Matrix show in the page head, and no edit bar.

Step 3:

  • The Matrices list shows again with 7 matrices (7 = 7).
  • No new matrix was added.
